channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: St. George’s new mayor outlines plans to tackle housing affordability and traffic
item.description: St. George's new mayor acknowledged that the fast-growing city needs to address key issues to keep up with its projected population boom.

item.title: Cache Valley locals: The Tribune wants to hear from you
item.description: As a nonprofit, The Salt Lake Tribune wants to know what topics deserve more coverage in Cache Valley. This short survey will help us cover what matters most to you.

item.title: Utah Christians celebrate the day with white snow and black ashes
item.description: Snow didn't dampen the enthusiasm of these Utah Christians, who observed the start of Lent at solemn Ash Wednesday services.

item.title: Tribune Editorial: Utah Republican lawmakers fail to see how well Utah Republicans have run our popular vote-by-mail system
item.description: “Unless one’s goal is to make it harder for qualified Utah voters to cast their ballots, there is no reason for [HB479],” the Tribune editorial board writes.

item.title: Due to ‘unprecedented demand,’ this Mormon wife is extending her Broadway stay
item.description: Whitney Leavitt will continue her run as Roxie Hart in "Chicago" through early April.

item.title: Why is the LDS Church dumping billions in stocks?
item.description: The overall value of the LDS Church's public investment portfolio has fallen after the church unloaded billions in stocks.

item.title: ‘The faucet is ON’: Utah’s first ‘real’ snowfall of the season dumps powder on ski resorts
item.description: The storm was also expected to bring "the highest accumulations" of snow the Salt Lake Valley has seen so far this season, a National Weather Service meteorologist in Salt Lake City said.

item.title: Arches National Park drops timed-entry reservations for 2026
item.description: Arches National Park will not require timed-entry reservations in 2026, allowing visitors to enter the park at any time during operating hours without a reservation.

item.title: There’s another big LDS closure coming in the heart of downtown Salt Lake City
item.description: The LDS Church will shut down — for the most part — its hulking Conference Center in downtown Salt Lake City for a year to gear up for the reopening of the neighboring Salt Lake Temple.

item.title: Federal judges appear skeptical of ruling in lawsuit over Utah’s new congressional maps
item.description: “Where’s the Utah Supreme Court on this important issue of state law,” a federal judge asked during a hearing on a lawsuit about Utah's new congressional maps.
